title: Space: Main Idea Mission
subject: Reading
learning_objective: Identify the main topic and retell key supporting details of an informational or narrative text.
instructions: Read the passage carefully. Look for the main idea and the details that support it. Use clues from the text when you answer.

story_content.opening: Nova checks a list of water pouches and tools. She wants to get them to friends on the Moon.
story_content.passage: Nova's crew must deliver four water pouches and two antenna tools before night cycle begins. The Moon has no air, so every checklist item matters. Nova reads the supply list aloud while a robot confirms each count. Craters make landing tricky, so the team practices a slow approach. When the final pouch is sealed, Nova marks the main goal: keep the outpost crew safely supplied.
story_content.ending: Great work exploring space ideas today!

questions.subject: reading
questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
choices: Careful supply checks keep the moon crew safe
The characters want to win a race
The weather report is the only topic
correct_answers: Careful supply checks keep the moon crew safe
questions.explanation: The passage repeatedly supports that central idea.
hints: Ask what the whole passage is mostly about.

questions.subject: reading
questions.prompt: Which detail best supports the main idea?
choices: Nova reads the supply list while a robot confirms each count
The characters want to win a race
The weather is the only topic
correct_answers: Nova reads the supply list while a robot confirms each count
questions.explanation: That detail directly backs the central message.
hints: Find a sentence that proves the main idea.

questions.subject: reading
questions.prompt: According to the passage, why does the character take notes or observe carefully?
choices: To keep the outpost crew safely supplied
To finish first in a contest
correct_answers: To keep the outpost crew safely supplied
questions.explanation: The text states the purpose of careful observation.
hints: Look for because / so / purpose language.

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: Nova packed 12 moon rocks in a crate. Then Nova added 5 more from a basket. How many moon rocks are in the crate now?
hints: Add the ones: 2 + 5 = 7, keep the ten.

common_mistakes: Choosing a detail instead of the main idea
Confusing the tens value with the tens digit itself
